The '''''Tidemaster''''' is a sunken frigate of the [[Kul Tiran Exploratory Fleet]] located in [[Shank's Reef]] on [[Lapidis Isle]]. Along with her sister ship, the ''[[Waterbreaker]]'', they were shipwrecked on the island while under attack from [[Southsea Pirates]]. The ''Tidemaster'' ran aground in Shank's Reef, where the rocks ripped the ship apart. Murlocs then attacked the crew, killing everyone aboard save for [[Wally Burnside]]. The [[Tidemaster's Logbook]] can be found aboard the wreck.
